answer_text:
Here are online beauty retailers (mostly US-accessible) that are known for carrying a *wide range of brands*—from prestige to indie to pro—along with what they’re best for:

## Big “multi-brand” selections (widest range)
- **Sephora** — Very broad prestige assortment across makeup, skincare, fragrance, and hair; lots of exclusives and minis.
- **Ulta Beauty** — One of the broadest mixes because it carries **both** drugstore + prestige, plus hair tools/salon brands.
- **Amazon (Beauty & Luxury Beauty)** — Huge breadth (mainstream + some prestige). Best if you’re careful about seller authenticity and buy “ships from/sold by” trusted listings.
- **Target (Beauty)** — Strong mix of mass + trending indie/drugstore skincare and haircare; increasingly broad online selection.

## Department stores (broad prestige + fragrance)
- **Nordstrom Beauty** — Wide prestige range, strong customer service/returns, good fragrance and haircare coverage.
- **Macy’s Beauty** / **Bloomingdale’s Beauty** — Broad prestige catalogs, especially fragrance and classic brands.
- **Saks Fifth Avenue Beauty** / **Neiman Marcus Beauty** — Stronger on luxury/designer beauty, fragrance, and high-end skincare.

## Beauty-specialty retailers (large + “enthusiast” friendly)
- **Dermstore** — Broad “derm” and clinical skincare focus (SkinCeuticals-type, sunscreen, treatments).
- **Space NK** — Great curated range of premium + niche skincare/makeup.
- **Beauty Bay** / **Cult Beauty** (UK-based, ship internationally) — Very broad assortment of trending brands; good for hard-to-find launches.

## Pro-focused (very wide in hair + pro makeup)
- **Sally Beauty** — Large hair color/haircare/tool range plus some skincare and nails.
- **CosmoProf** (often license-gated) — Pro salon brands; wide if you have access.
- **Camera Ready Cosmetics** — Strong pro makeup/FX/setting powders/tools selection.

## Brand “marketplaces” that expand range
- **Revolve Beauty** — Growing mix of clean/luxury/indie.
- **Walmart Beauty** — Very broad mass assortment online; like Amazon, marketplace listings vary, so check sellers.

---

If you tell me (1) your budget (drugstore, mid, luxury), (2) what categories matter most (skincare/makeup/hair/fragrance), and (3) whether you care about “clean” brands or dermatologist-grade, I can shortlist the 3–5 best retailers for you.
query_text: Which online beauty retailers have a wide range of brands?
